purpose: Test the necessary condition for a legal privileged-information distillation: whether official historical post-pitch TrackMan physics predicts control_success beyond pitch identity and pre-pitch context out of time.

data_rules.target_year_trackman_use: diagnostic scoring only; never an inference feature

folds.history_rule: regular-season matched rows with season strictly before target year

metrics.primary: paired Brier gain of physics_teacher over control, normalized with the target-fold R rate
metrics.uncertainty: pitcher-cluster bootstrap 95% lower bound with 1000 fixed-seed replicates

requirements: positive normalized paired Brier gain in 2021, 2022, and 2023
positive pitcher-cluster 95% gain lower bound in at least two of the three years
proceed_gate.on_pass: preregister a separate history-only teacher-profile distillation on 2022 and 2023; current/validation TrackMan remains unavailable to that candidate
proceed_gate.on_fail: reject privileged TrackMan teacher direction without reading 2024
